overview.text: Soil_1_22 is a biosynthetic gene cluster identified by DeepBGC and GECCO, with no compound class assigned.
It spans 11 kb on contig_1 from position 2,861,769 to 2,872,845 and contains 11 genes.

genes.text: The cluster contains 2 regulatory, 2 transport, 2 tailoring-enzyme and 3 resistance genes, with no core biosynthetic gene detected by any tool.

similar.text: This locus has not been compared with MIBiG, as the comparison was performed by antiSMASH, which did not detect the cluster.

hypothesis.text: The presence of cytochrome P450 enzymes, phosphoserine transaminase, and threonine dehydratase suggests the cluster may be involved in amino acid modification or primary metabolic processes rather than specialised metabolite biosynthesis.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_22 is a biosynthetic gene cluster, found by DeepBGC and GECCO; no compound class is assigned to it.
It spans 11 kb on contig_1 (2,861,769–2,872,845) and contains 11 genes.
By the annotation categories of BGC-XPLORER, it holds 2 regulatory, 2 transport, 2 tailoring-enzyme and 3 resistance genes.
No detection tool names a core biosynthetic gene inside the agreed span of this locus.

Gene products in the locus, in genome order: CJLEIP_02459 sensor histidine kinase KdpD; CJLEIP_02460 Roadblock/LC7 domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_02461 DUF742 domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_02462 ATP-binding protein; CJLEIP_02463 Cytochrome P450; CJLEIP_02464 Cytochrome P450; CJLEIP_02465 phosphoserine transaminase; CJLEIP_02466 Threonine dehydratase; CJLEIP_02467 Transport permease protein; CJLEIP_02468 ATP-binding cassette domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_02469 TetR/AcrR family transcriptional regulator.
This locus has not been compared with MIBiG: the comparison is made by antiSMASH, which did not detect it.
